citations.narrative:
When the inspector called the licensee to announce their presence to conduct an inspection, the licensee stated they had
moved an hour away. The licensee provided the inspector with the new address over the phone at the time of the
attempted inspection when requested. The licensee had notified the inspector of an impending business change via
phone call in April 2026, but did not provide a new physical address verbally or in written correspondence. Failure to notify
Animal Care of a change in location and the new physical address can make it difficult to verify regulated activities and
ensure the health and wellbeing of regulated animals. A licensee shall notify Animal Care no fewer than 90 days before
any change in the name, address, management, substantial control or ownership of his business or operation, locations,
activities, and number or type of animals. Correct from this date forward.

citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 8:45 AM on 07
August 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by calling the phone number provided; the licensee
answered and stated they had moved. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a
violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
